description: Remeshes the full Geological Model Meshes object using configurable remeshing parameters to improve triangle quality while preserving the model structure.

initial_cleanup.description: Whether to run initial cleanup such as node merging, gap filling, and topological fixing.
initial_cleanup.title: Initial Cleanup

is_closed.description: Whether the mesh is closed; should be true for manifold GMVs.
is_closed.title: Is Closed

line_proximity_detection.description: Whether to consider distance between skeleton lines when sizing elements.
line_proximity_detection.title: Line Proximity Detection

max_chordal_error.description: Maximum relative local error. -0.005 corresponds to 0.5%.
max_chordal_error.title: Max Chordal Error

patch_angle_tolerance.description: Angle change in degrees used to define a patch skeleton line.
patch_angle_tolerance.title: Patch Angle Tolerance

regularize_mode.description: If true, do not remesh; only regularize the mesh.
regularize_mode.title: Regularize Mode

relax_chunk_interfaces.description: Whether to relax chunk interfaces during remeshing.
relax_chunk_interfaces.title: Relax Chunk Interfaces

source.description: The mesh to process. Supports Triangle Mesh and Geological Model Meshes.
source.title: Input Mesh

strain_tolerance.description: Relative quality difference before and after unfolding to a plane.
strain_tolerance.title: Strain Tolerance

target.description: Target specifying where to create the output mesh object. Provide an object with a reference field containing a path-based geoscience object URL and an overwrite field containing a boolean value.

description.description: Description to put into the target object.
description.title: Description

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite the existing object.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

tags.description: Tags to put into the target object.
tags.title: Tags

target.title: Target

target_h.description: Target element size. Zero bases the size on skeleton lines.
target_h.title: Target Edge Length

message.description: Description of the result of the operation.
message.title: Message

object.description: The new mesh object with the remeshing applied.

examples.description: The new mesh object with the remeshing applied.
examples.name: output.json

description.description: The description of the geoscience object.
description.title: Description

name.description: The name of the geoscience object.
name.title: Name

schema_id.description: The ID of the Geoscience Object schema.
schema_id.title: Schema ID

object.title: Output Mesh
